title: Bright Evidence Normalize Input
description: Deterministic normalization request for caller-provided public-source evidence.

subject.description: Canonical research subject used for alias normalization and evidence identity.

aliases.description: Known subject aliases that should normalize to the canonical subject.

researchQuery.description: Optional research query or scope that produced these candidates.

researchedAt.description: Optional ISO date/date-time when the research was performed.

items.description: Candidate evidence items. The structured branch documents the expected item contract; the permissive fallback keeps malformed individual items batch-safe so they can be returned in rejectedItems instead of rejecting the whole call.

maxEvidence.description: Target retained-evidence cap. Unresolved conflict groups may exceed this cap rather than being silently truncated.

nearDuplicateThreshold.description: Token-set similarity threshold for guarded deterministic near-duplicate merging.

evidenceItem.description: One atomic factual assertion with a public source URL and optional provenance/typed fact metadata.

claim.description: Atomic factual claim supported by the source.

url.description: Public http(s) source URL supporting the claim. URLs containing username/password userinfo credentials are batch-rejected.

publishedAt.description: ISO date/date-time when the source was published.

excerpt.description: Short source excerpt directly supporting the claim.

category.description: Fact category used for guarded dedupe and conflict comparison.

sourceType.description: Source-type hint such as official, primary, news, analytics, social, or aggregator.

sourceRelationship.description: Optional deterministic source relationship. Independence is explicit: only independent means independently established provenance.

claimDate.description: ISO date/date-time the factual claim refers to; for event facts this may itself be the disputed value.

value.description: Optional explicit typed value extracted from the claim.

unit.description: Optional unit associated with value, such as followers, subscribers, views, or percent.
